 Why Fans Think Food Network Judge Carla Hall Is Leaving: Rumors Explained
 Shazmeen Navrange 2026년 11월 9일 월 오전 4:40 UTC 0 Photo Credit: Food Network According to the latest report, Carla Hall may not return to Food Network , leaving fans shocked. It revealed the reason behind the departure and what she has decided to do next. She has been a part of the network’s baking competition since 2020.
 Is Carla Hall leaving Food Network?
 A report suggests that Hall’s professional relationship with Food Networ k may have concluded. However, neither party has addressed this news publicly. 
 The US Sun reported that Hall may not be continuing her professional ties with Food Network. A source told the outlet, “Carla is focusing on her shows on other networks and on her personal projects like her book.” They added that Hall isn’t speaking to the network and that their relationship may have ended.
 The insider mentioned, “There’s no hard feelings on the network’s side, but there are no discussions to bring Carla back for anything.  Nothing extremely negative happened between Food Network and Carla, it’s just business.” Alongside Hall, Jozef Youssef also didn’t return for Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking Season 3. The duo has been replaced by  Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain as judges.
 The series premiered on November 4. Its description read, “The first challenge for the teams is to create confections inspired by ‘Memorable Firsts’ from the first movie, Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone, and present the cakes for judging against the backdrop of the legendary Quidditch Pitch.” The second challenge will be about the bakers showcasing their skills to create a masterpiece inspired by their favorite spells.
 The teams are as follows: 
 Advertisement
 Team Gryffindor- Andy Ortega, Angel Figueroa, and Rui Mota
 Team Hufflepuff- Elizabeth Rowe, Molly Robbins, and Priya Winsor
 Team Ravenclaw – Caitlin Taylor, Jujhar Mann, and Kimberly Adams
 Team Slytherin -Christopher Teixeira, Hemu Basumatary, and Miko Uy.
 Ahead of joining the baking competition, Hall was also a part of Top Chef: New York and Top Chef: All-Stars. She also co-hosted The Chew.
